query: Is the Aurelio Presto 200 espresso machine still available from Fictive Retail, and what should a buyer choose instead?

matches.title: Fictive Retail catalogue: Aurelio Presto 200 espresso machine
matches.text:
# Fictive Retail catalogue: Aurelio Presto 200 espresso machine

Structured product data from the Fictive Retail merchandising system.
Record updated: 1 August 2026.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| SKU | AUR-P200 |
| Brand | Aurelio |
| Product | Presto 200 espresso machine |
| Price | not sold |
| Stock | none — discontinued |

The Aurelio Presto 200 was discontinued on 15 July 2026 and is no longer
stocked by Fictive Retail. It is replaced by the Aurelio Presto 300, which
uses the same portafilter size; Presto 200 water filters remain available
while remaining warehouse stock lasts.

matches.title: Fictive Retail compatibility matrix: grinders and espresso machines
matches.text:
# Fictive Retail compatibility matrix: grinders and espresso machines

Structured product data from the Fictive Retail merchandising system.
Record updated: 1 August 2026.

| Grinder | Machine | Compatible | Requires |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northglade G4 | Aurelio Presto 300 | yes | dose adapter ring DR-2, grinder firmware 2.1 |
| Northglade G4 | Aurelio Presto 200 | no | — |

From 28 March 2026, the Northglade G4 burr grinder is compatible with the
Aurelio Presto 300 auto-dose tray when fitted with the dose adapter ring
DR-2 and running grinder firmware 2.1 or later. Earlier G4 firmware does not
signal dose completion to the tray, and no adapter is made for the
discontinued Presto 200.

The Aurelio Presto 300 is in stock at £329.00. At 21 cm wide, it is the
narrowest machine in the Aurelio range and the current model in the Presto
line. The auto-dose tray accepts ground coffee directly or a compatible
grinder fitted per the Fictive Retail compatibility matrix.

The Aurelio milk wand (SKU AUR-MW) was discontinued on 2 July 2026 and is
replaced by the steam tip set ST-1, in stock at £39.00; the ST-1 fits the
steam arm of both the Presto 200 and the Presto 300. The WF-30 water
filter for the Presto 300 (SKU AUR-WF30, £12.00) is in stock. Presto 200
WF-20 water filters are sold from remaining warehouse stock with no
further production, and WF-20 filters do not fit the Presto 300 reservoir.

The Aurelio BrewLink Hub was discontinued on 5 July 2026 and has no
replacement product. Since the Aurelio Home app update of 10 July 2026, a
Presto 300 running machine firmware 3.0 or later connects directly over
Wi-Fi with no hub hardware; a machine on earlier firmware updates from
its settings menu.

matches.title: Fictive Retail catalogue: Northglade G4 burr grinder
matches.text:

Structured product data from the Fictive Retail merchandising system.
Record updated: 1 August 2026.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| SKU | NG-G4 |
| Brand | Northglade |
| Product | G4 burr grinder |
| Price | £129.00 |
| Stock | In stock |

The Northglade G4 is in stock at £129.00, reduced from £159.00 on
18 July 2026. Units sold by Fictive Retail after 1 May 2026 ship with
grinder firmware 2.1 pre-installed; the dose adapter ring DR-2 (SKU
NG-DR2, £15.00, in stock) is sold separately and is required to feed the
Aurelio Presto 300 auto-dose tray. The replacement burr set BS-40 (SKU
NG-BS40, £24.00) is in stock.
